description: This Swift source file extends the VoiceWakeOverlayController class with additional methods to manage overlay window presentation, positioning, sizing, and dismissal behaviors in a macOS application.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Prepares and presents the overlay window with the voice wake UI, handling first presentation and re-visibility.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window with content view, setting up layout and appearance if not already created.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to the front if it is currently visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for positioning the overlay window on the main screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the overlay window's frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the overlay content based on attributed text and layout constraints.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Computes a modified frame for dismissing the overlay, with different adjustments based on dismissal reason and outcome.
